name: RR
advice: Save most RR for units that remain useful in boss fights, story clears, and late-game content.

name: Divine
bestFor: High-end DPS units and top Secret or Mythic carries
advice: Keep this on main damage carries and avoid replacing it casually.

name: Stellar
advice: Keep it as a strong DPS option when the unit benefits from damage-over-time pressure.

name: Sniper
advice: Use it on units built for boss damage or crit-based single-target output.

name: Tycoon
advice: Keep it on economy or support units instead of forcing pure DPS traits onto them.

name: Jack of All
advice: Accept it as an early useful roll, but do not spend heavy RR chasing perfect traits on temporary units.

name: Cubes
advice: Collect from code rewards and farming routes, then spend through the relevant in-game upgrade systems.

name: Malice
advice: Claim from the SorryForDelay code and keep it for the in-game system that requires it.

name: Ninja
advice: Strong A-tier trait for units that rely on attack speed, like Crimson Knight. Boosts attack speed by 20%.

name: Starlight
advice: Solid B-tier trait for units that deal hybrid or full AOE damage, like Founding Titan. Adds 15% AOE damage.

name: Elemental
bestFor: Units with elemental effects (frost, poison, fire)
advice: Decent C-tier trait for utility units like Frozen Moon or Insect Slayer. Enhances elemental effect duration by 25%.

name: Godspeed
bestFor: Units that benefit from repositioning and dodge
advice: C-tier trait for endless mode survivability. Grants 10% dodge chance and 15% movement speed. Situational but fun.
